title: Stoner Recreation Center – Grant of Right Between the Department of
text:
Stoner Recreation Center – Grant of Right Between the Department of
  Recreation and Parks and the Department of Public Works for Sidewalk Repair
  Program – Determination that the Project is Within the Scope of the Sidewalk
  Repair Program (SRP) and the SRP Environmental Impact Report (Sch
  #2017071063) Adequately Describes the Project, Pursuant to Section 15168(e)
  [Notice with Later Activities of Program EIR] of State CEQA Guidelines and that
  No New Mitigation and No New Environmental Document or Public Recirculation
  are Required Per Sections 15168(c) And 15162 of CEQA Guidelines
